column1: # Bloom scenes: Tolbi harbour, Altin Peak miner, Mogall aftermath.

column3: Isaac, someone is crying\ndown at the docks. It\nsounds like a child.{end_wait}
That's a boy's voice. We\nshould go and find out\nwhat happened to him.{end_wait}
Go if you like. The water\ntakes what it takes, and\nthe sea doesn't care.{end_wait}
Come with me. We'll find\nyou somewhere warm and\nsafe, I promise.{end_wait}
He's calmer already. The\nvoices fade when someone\nlistens to him.{end_wait}
I'll get him settled at the\ninn first. It's the least\nwe can do.{end_wait}
I'm sorry. We can't carry\nevery child in this town.{end_wait}
He was still crying as we\nleft. I'll hear it for a\nlong time, Isaac.{end_wait}
Why did you pull me out?\nThe light is so loud, and\nit hurts to look at it.{end_wait}
His thoughts just went\nquiet, Isaac. All of them,\nall at once.{end_wait}
Look at his eyes, Isaac.\nThey've turned grey.{end_wait}
Will you stay with him\nuntil it passes?{end_now}
Thank you. Please don't go\nyet. I don't want to be\nalone when it takes me.{end_wait}
He's gone, Isaac. There's\nnothing left in there to\nsave, so don't watch him.{end_wait}
At least that boy in Tolbi\nis safe now. That has to\ncount for something.{end_wait}
I keep thinking about that\nboy on the docks, Ivan. I\ncan't stop hearing him.{end_wait}
